title: Rory and the Moonlit Fern Lagoon
verses:
The stars started twinkling so soft and so bright,
And painted the valley in blue velvet light.
When Rory walked slow through the fern-covered glade,
He listened to music the gentle breeze made.

Then Psittaco chirped from his snug little nest,
And Nia swooped down for a moment of rest.
She whispered that night-time was coming to stay,
To fold up the light at the end of the day.

Beside the cool water sat Benny so still,
As Tilly hummed softly from high on the hill.
They gathered soft moss that was fluffy and deep,
To make a warm bed for a quiet night's sleep.

Then Ricky stepped softly and slowed down his pace,
And found a calm nook in their favorite place.
He snuggled by Rory and closed both his eyes,
Beneath the sweet glow of the slumbering skies.

Now Psittaco tucked under Nia's warm wing,
As night began softly to murmur and sing.
The waters were glowing with silvery gleam,
And floated the friends toward a beautiful dream.

So Rory sighed happy and rested his head,
Upon the soft moss of his dream-covered bed.
With all of his cozy friends snoring so light,
He whispered, "Sweet dreams, and a lovely goodnight."
